review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of cs_app::mission_control::survey_mission_control_programs over the installation (m01-directives.json). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: the task's four items are each discharged by the findings the candidate tree holds. Item 1, IDENTITY - measured as presentation data (PresentationIdentity: the class spelling selects the completion sound channel and HUD class, the integer is the HUD slot ordinal); block identity is the zero-based record index every cross-objective directive spells, which is what each of the 58 lowered RawObjective's SymbolId carries. Item 2, the inactive ladder - every one of M01's 18 INACTIVE<n> keys is measured InactiveMembers beside INACTIVE_COMPLETION_COUNT's InactiveThreshold, and 12 of the 58 lowered conditions carry Condition::InactiveMembers with the threshold defaulting to the block's own member count. Item 3, nested argument shapes - the IR's Value::List carries them structure-for-structure: 7 M01 keys spell a nested shape (ANIM_STATE, SET_HELP_LABEL, ADD_OBJECTIVE_TARGET, SET_AI_NET among them) and every emitted RawCall's shape is one of the shapes the census measured its key spelling, never a flattened positional row. Item 4, disagreeing shapes - 9 M01 keys spell more than one shape and each stays Measured with one registered signature per measured shape; no plurality is resolved. HARD CONSTRAINTS: over M01's 43 keys (41 measured + 2 terminal + 0 unmeasured), all 353 sites bound into 353 call verdict(s), validation reports true and is_complete() is true - while across the corpus 6 distinct keys over 40 measured row(s) of 53 mission-scoped reader(s) still carry a named Unmeasured reason, 64 lowering row(s) stay unmet corpus-wide, 13 reader(s) declare no control program and campaign_ready() is false with 14 mission(s) complete. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED: this is a static lowering of the record into the IR - no original program was run and no mission was played, so nothing here is verified_original behaviour, and a bound Action::Directive emits the measured operation to the host without proving a world-side handler exists. TEST-SELECTION NOTE: the prefix accept_m01_lc_directives_ is unique to this task, so the 10 discovered assertions are exactly this task's tests. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
